<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Antigravity"> <diagram name="Policy-Guardrails" id="guardrails_diag"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="560" pageHeight="550" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<mxCell id="grp_guardrails" value="Policy Guardrail &amp; Escalation Flow" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;startSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="20" width="520" height="500" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="start_eval" value="<b>check_refund_eligibility(order_id)</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="grp_guardrails"> <mxGeometry x="120" y="50" width="280" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="d1" value="Is status == 'Refunded'?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="grp_guardrails"> <mxGeometry x="150" y="120" width="220" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_start_d1" edge="1" parent="grp_guardrails" source="start_eval" target="d1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_d1_yes" value="YES" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="grp_guardrails" source="d1" target="res_ineligible"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="res_ineligible" value="<b>Ineligible</b><br><font style="font-size: 10px;">Action denied</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="grp_guardrails"> <mxGeometry x="410" y="130" width="95" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="d2" value="Days since order &gt; 30?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="grp_guardrails"> <mxGeometry x="150" y="210" width="220" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_d1_no" value="NO" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="grp_guardrails" source="d1" target="d2"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_d2_yes" value="YES" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="grp_guardrails" source="d2" target="res_esc_days"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="res_esc_days" value="<b>Escalate</b><br><font style="font-size: 10px;">&gt; 30-day window</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="grp_guardrails"> <mxGeometry x="410" y="220" width="95" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="d3" value="Product price &gt; $500?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="grp_guardrails"> <mxGeometry x="150" y="300" width="220" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_d2_no" value="NO" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="grp_guardrails" source="d2" target="d3"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_d3_yes" value="YES" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="grp_guardrails" source="d3" target="res_esc_price"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="res_esc_price" value="<b>Escalate</b><br><font style="font-size: 10px;">&gt; $500 limit</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="grp_guardrails"> <mxGeometry x="410" y="310" width="95" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="res_eligible" value="<b>Eligible for Automated Refund</b><br><font style="font-size: 11px;">Order Operations executes cancel_order or process_refund</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;" vertex="1" parent="grp_guardrails"> <mxGeometry x="100" y="395" width="320" height="65" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_d3_no" value="NO" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="grp_guardrails" source="d3" target="res_eligible"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
svg.text: Order Operations executes cancel_order or process_refund
